_comment: Light / intense mood, derived from Jellyfin genres. Names are compared without case, accents, dashes or spaces, so 'Science-Fiction' = 'science fiction'. A title gets one point per genre found in a list; the side with more points wins, a tie (or no known genre) means 'other' and the title stays on both sides. To adjust: copy this file to /config/moods.json and edit it, Quizzarr reads that copy first.
